rationale: Reviewed commit 446900446205ebac7c5c35fb26ef7c5f29c05cc6 is confined to exactly five files: internal/bead/bdcli.go, internal/bead/bdcli_test.go, internal/next/beads.go, internal/next/beads_test.go, and internal/next/ready_gate.go. Neither cmd/mindspec/next.go nor internal/next/guard.go is touched, and the complete bead delta from fork point bed348c2 has the same five-file confinement. The new unexported bdRenderedError introduces no injection surface through Error(): it obtains the underlying error text, splits on LF, applies termsafe.Escape to every line, and only that escaped representation is consumed by each outer fmt.Errorf %w; Unwrap exposes the original error solely for errors.Is/errors.As traversal. Focused stderr/render/chain tests and a scratch build passed; go test -race ./internal/bead ./internal/next and go test ./... -short also completed green. G3's describePhaseSyncFailure deferral is honest. Its RecordReadinessOverride rationale is factually incomplete because MergeMetadata and DeleteMetadataKeys first call GetMetadata through tracedOutput, so their read failures can already carry folded stderr, but this narrow terminal-rendering residual cannot corrupt the spec branch and therefore is non-blocking under this panel's explicit threshold.

findings.title: Five-file confinement and parallel-track isolation verified
findings.detail: git show/diff-tree at 44690044 names exactly bdcli.go, bdcli_test.go, beads.go, beads_test.go, and ready_gate.go. cmd/mindspec/next.go and internal/next/guard.go are absent; no exported contract changes were introduced.

findings.title: bdRenderedError preserves classification without opening a raw Error rendering path
findings.detail: Error() delegates to renderBDError, which applies termsafe.Escape independently to every LF-delimited line; control, invalid UTF-8, bidi, and non-ASCII-bearing lines are quoted without raw control bytes. All production constructions pass the wrapper through %w, whose displayed string is therefore escaped, while Unwrap returns the original error for errors.As/errors.Is. The real RunBD chain tests passed for *exec.ExitError reachability and IsUnsupportedFlagError classification.

findings.title: G3 override-path deferral rationale overlooks the armed metadata read half
findings.detail: At 44690044, RecordReadinessOverride and RollbackReadinessOverride delegate errors unchanged. MergeMetadata/DeleteMetadataKeys call GetMetadata first, and that read uses tracedOutput, so a read failure can contain newly folded hostile bd stderr even though the later write uses tracedCombined. The reviewed commit's statement that this leg is not yet armed describes only the write half. This is a terminal-rendering residual, not a spec-branch-corrupting defect, so the panel's binding R6 threshold does not permit blocking on it. describePhaseSyncFailure is separately and honestly deferred because its render site is in concurrent bead-7's cmd/mindspec/next.go.

findings.title: Verification passed and scratch artifacts were cleaned
findings.detail: Focused chain/render tests passed in internal/bead and internal/next, the binary built to /tmp, package race tests passed, and the repository-wide short suite passed. The dedicated /tmp scratch directory was removed. During the broader suites, unrelated concurrent edits appeared in three bead-worktree files; they were not authored, discarded, or overwritten by this reviewer, and this verdict remains pinned to the immutable reviewed commit.
